topic: The plague that wiped out half of Europe in just three years
hook: Half of Europe died in three years. Nobody knew why.
script: Half of Europe died in three years. Nobody knew why. The Black Death arrived in 1347 on merchant ships. Within three years, 25 million Europeans were dead. Bodies piled in streets. Doctors fled cities. People believed it was divine punishment. It wasn't until 1894 that scientists discovered the bacteria responsible. Five centuries of not knowing. Follow for history's most terrifying turning points.
